title: Modulation of pentraxin 3 by vinpocetine ameliorates lung Inflammation in murine model of allergic asthma exacerbated by lipopolysaccharide.
snippet: This study investigates the pathological role of pentraxin 3 (PTX3) and evaluates the therapeutic efficacy of vinpocetine (VINP) in a murine mixed granulocytic asthma (MGA) model induced by co‑exposure to ovalbumin (OVA) and lipopolysaccharide (LPS).
